propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is read by _private_key_env() into the config object but never removed from os.environ, leaving it accessible to child processes and environment dumps.

The inline-PEM source path (dev/compat mode) allows ssh-keygen and git subprocesses spawned after config load to inherit the raw PEM through os.environ, since they do not receive explicit env= arguments.

Consuming the environment variable with os.environ.pop() after capturing it in _private_key_env() transfers the secret into the config object and removes it from the process environment before any child processes are spawned.

A second call to OpcertServiceConfig.from_env() in the same process must return private_key as None without raising, pinning the consume-once contract to prevent silent failures if a reload path is added in the future.
The environment registry generator must continue to recognize REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY after the fix, requiring the read to remain as os.environ.get() with the pop in a separate statement.
